motions.name: broken_1
motions.line: There are so many strange people like me here. Some like collecting buttons, others like dismantling their enemies... Hm? Didn't you know? The plush I gave you earlier contains parts from my enemies.

motions.name: broken_2
motions.line: This is supposed to be my day... So why does everyone run away the moment they see me? How am I going to get candy like this... Looks like I'll have to play hardball.

motions.name: broken_4
motions.line: Everyone keeps calling me a ragpicker Doll. I'm visibly a collector, and those guys have no aesthetic sense at all. You think so too, right?

motions.name: broken_5
motions.line: ...Do I have to turn this in to the warehouse too? Meanie.

motions.name: login
motions.line: I wore a new uniform to work today, Boss. Give me a new button for the one on top.

motions.name: touch_2
motions.line: ...There are so many rules in Griffin; are you going to check my luggage too? It's filled with food for Cutie, as well as plushies I picked up during my travels. If you see one you like, then I can give it to you.

motions.name: touch_3
motions.line: Are you sure you want to take Cutie for a walk with me, Boss? In that case, I'll see you at midnight tonight in the little patch of woods in the southwest corner of the Griffin Base. You might run into a ghost if you go around that time, I hear.

motions.name: touch_4
motions.line: This is supposed to be my day... So why does everyone run away the moment they see me? How am I going to get candy like this... Looks like I'll have to play hardball.

motions.name: touch_5
motions.line: Time to work, time to work. Surely nobody's better at slacking off than me, hm?

motions.name: wedding
motions.line: Does this count as a mission, Boss? Or are you saying that I can choose as I like?<>I'm just kidding, there's only one answer I want to give.<>After all, the only human who can accept all my weirdness is you, Boss.

motions.name: wedding_touch
motions.line: What's wrong, you don't like how I redecorated your office? These plushies are my pride and joy, and when I'm not around, they'll watch you on my behalf...
